name: Personal Coppelia
source:
An NSFW yuri kinetic novel about dolls, idealization, and becoming something not quite human and not quite a doll at the whim of a hot older woman. 

[From [url=https://iconoclastgirlfriend.itch.io/wip-personal-coppelia]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部围绕人偶、理想化投射展开的成人向百合无选项视觉小说，讲述了在一位性感年长女性的一时兴起之下，逐渐蜕变为非人亦非偶之物的故事。

[摘自[url=https://iconoclastgirlfriend.itch.io/wip-personal-coppelia]itch.io[/url]]
